messages:
miguel: Quick status check — retention cutover is scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT. We still need: trace hook enablement in staging, error-analysis views finalized, and owners signed off on the canary plan. Who can own each piece?

lucy: I can take the dashboards/error-analysis views. Will push PR by EOD today for the UI panels and dashboards.

sam: I can own the trace hook rollout and the staging canary. Need confirmation on sampling rate (default 10%?) and whether we enable prefix caching telemetry. @anya any constraints from runtime?

anya: Sampling 10% is fine for staging; for prod we want 1% default then raise for specific paths. Runtime note: the trace hook requires a small config change to the KV cache warmup — I'll open the infra change PR now.

miguel: Thanks. Can we list owners in one place so product can sign off? My suggested owners: trace hooks = sam, runtime change = anya, dashboards = lucy, canary plan = sam + eng-sre, product signoff = erin. Agree?

erin: Agree. I can do a final pass on the error metrics (false-positive alerts) and the gating conditions. Ping me when dashboards PR is up.

cheng: Quick ask from model infra: will the hooks include model variant in the trace metadata? We need that to correlate regressions.

anya: Good catch — yes we can add model_variant to the span tags. I'll add in the PR.

sam: Canary steps (draft):
1) Deploy runtime + trace hook to staging.
2) Run synthetic trace load for 30m at 10% sampling.
3) Run `curl` canary to exercise common error paths and long-seq gen.
4) Monitor error rate & latency histograms for 60m.

Example canary curl:```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-infer.redwood.internal/canary \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<canary-prompt>","tokens":50}'
```

lucy: Dashboard checklist:
- Error classification view (5 main buckets)
- Per-route latency p50/p95/p99
- Trace waterfall for correlated errors
- Retention heatmap by route
Will wire up alert thresholds after PR.

miguel: Great. Two blockers: (1) eng-ml needs model_variant in traces (cheng confirmed), (2) security asked about leakage of prompt text in traces — we must redact prompts before storing spans. Who takes that?

anya: I'll add prompt redaction step in the runtime; small performance hit but necessary. Will note in PR.

sam: I'll coordinate with sec on verification steps. Also adding canary-bot to post updates to #incidents during the cutover.

canary-bot: scheduled canary job created for 2026-04-07T16:00:00Z; posting to #incidents on start/finish.

erin: Ok — action items for me: review dashboards after lucy PR, confirm gating thresholds. For product, I'll sign off by Mon noon if no surprises.

miguel: Summary of owners & next steps:
- Trace hook rollout: sam (PR in progress)
- Runtime config + prompt redaction + model_variant tagging: anya (PR incoming)
- Dashboards & error views: lucy (PR by EOD)
- Canary execution + alerts monitoring: sam + canary-bot
- Product signoff: erin (Mon noon)
- Model correlation: cheng (verify tags)

If everyone confirms ownership I will update the milestone doc and schedule the cutover. :thumbsup:

lucy: Confirmed.

sam: Confirmed, will start staging run once anya's runtime PR is merged.

anya: Confirmed, will add prompt redaction & model_variant tags in the runtime PR.

cheng: Confirmed on tags, will validate after PR merge.

erin: Confirmed.

miguel: Thanks all — I'll update the milestone doc and drop a reminder in #all-hands for visibility.
